Reading the charts below: everything sits on one axis, population exposed. Dots are the current estimates by source (labelled beneath the axis) · vertical ticks are past storms since 2002, and the grey curve their distribution · the coloured curve is the forecast probabilistic distribution of exposure from NHC's wind-speed probabilities — its spike at the low end is the chance that little or no further exposure happens · a dashed line marks exposure already observed.
